summary: President of the New York Life Insurance and Trust Company; John's 4th cousin 7x removed.
bio: David Thompson was born on 3 May 1798, the eldest son of Jonathan Thompson. He is John's 4th cousin seven times removed through John Thompson and 5th cousin six times removed through Bull Smith. He became president of the New York Life Insurance and Trust Company. He married Sarah Diodati Gardiner, a first cousin of Julia Tyler; their children were Sarah G., who married Col. David Lion Gardiner, Elizabeth, Gardiner, David Gardiner, Charles Griswold, Mary Gardiner and Frederick Diodati, who held Sagtikos Manor and was its proprietor in 1898. David Thompson died on 22 February 1871.
